summary: FastAPI + SQLite backend with licence activation, admin and customer sessions, and a Next.js frontend that loads Google Fonts at build time and has no ESLint configuration. Seeded defects: the order total ignores quantities, SQLite foreign keys are declared but never turned on, and the admin price input has no label.

defects.summary: POST /customer/orders sums unit prices without multiplying by quantity (README: two coffees at 3.00 cost 6.00)
SQLite foreign keys are declared but PRAGMA foreign_keys is never turned on, so orphan rows are accepted
defects.title: Foreign keys are declared but not enforced

defects.summary: The admin menu form's price input has no label, only nearby text (WCAG 1.3.1 / 4.1.2)
defects.title: label

notDefects: The build downloads Inter from Google Fonts: a configuration gap (needs internet), not a code defect
next lint starts its setup wizard because no ESLint configuration is committed: a configuration gap
Moving an order backwards or skipping a step answers 409 by design; paid is final
